g2e_baseline.pin_reason: P1.5 is the latest provider-neutral qualification candidate before actual-harness/transport experiments; P1.5 preserves P1.4 semantics and does not authorize runtime adapters.

reusable_adapter.reason: P4 adapter targets legacy GWF 0.8.5 domain/workunit surfaces; semantic rules are reusable but runtime coupling must be reconciled.

qualification_tests.reason: Old PASS proves the pinned baseline only; vNext implementation must rerun adapted tests.

transport_experiment.note: P5A/CGW/Codex/product-smoke material remains separate from provider-neutral semantic/runtime reconciliation.

canonical_mapping.per_scope_cardinality: one G2E exact revision -> at most one active canonical GWF mirror; same exact ref may be mirrored in multiple runtime/project scopes

proof_to_execution.proof_to_attempt: 1 ProofObligation revision -> 0..N ExecutionAttempt identities as allowed by frozen retry/multipart policy
proof_to_execution.attempt_to_work_assignment: In GWF mode, exactly 1 frozen G2E ExecutionAttempt -> exactly 1 GWF WorkAssignment revision for that dispatch
proof_to_execution.runtime_retry_expansion: FORBIDDEN; replacement attempt must be created by G2E under frozen retry policy

agent_to_executor.agent_binding_cardinality: agent-backed G2E ExecutionAttempt -> exactly 1 G2E AgentBinding; non-agent attempt -> 0
agent_to_executor.executor_binding_cardinality: dispatched GWF WorkAssignment -> exactly 1 resolved ExecutorBinding
agent_to_executor.bridge_cardinality: agent-backed GWF attempt -> exactly 1 AgentBinding <-> exactly 1 ExecutorBinding for the attempt
resolution_order: GWF WorkAssignment freezes/authorizes exact attempt refs
GWF ExecutorBinding resolves compatible execution environment

identity_projection.rule: GWF agent_identity must be an exact non-widening projection of G2E AgentBinding identity; runtime observations are evidence, not silent binding mutation.

capability_domains.gwf_executor_binding_capability_manifest: must map the exact G2E AgentCapabilityManifest for agent-backed attempts

binding_mode_rules: G2E DYNAMIC may resolve to GWF DYNAMIC or stricter FROZEN, but both are immutable within the attempt after resolution
material substitution requires a new G2E ExecutionAttempt and new GWF WorkAssignment/ExecutorBinding
agent_to_executor.equivalence_policy: GWF equivalence_policy_ref must preserve/map the exact G2E AgentEquivalencePolicy; GWF may narrow but not widen substitutions.
agent_to_executor.authority_rule: effective GWF AuthorityEnvelope must be a subset/equal to G2E AgentBinding authority_scope and upstream proof/goal authority
agent_to_executor.qualification_authority_rule: G2E QualificationAuthorityGrant is qualification-only and may never be reused as operational ExecutorBinding authority

protected_resource.governance_enforcer: GWF may enforce equal-or-stricter profile/authority/budget constraints
protected_resource.exact_ref_propagation: Every G2E protected_resource_ref used by an attempt must be present unchanged in WorkAssignment protected_resource_constraints and consumption lineage.
protected_resource.exposure_timing: before or atomically with outcome availability to human/agent/downstream process
protected_resource.profile_firewall: research profile rules may block access earlier; they cannot make G2E-disallowed access admissible
protected_resource.budget_rule: GWF hard budget/protected-consumption ceiling may be stricter; expansion requires governed authorization

candidate_flow: Executor/runtime emits candidate payload and runtime provenance
bridge verifies exact attempt, AgentBinding/ExecutorBinding when applicable, environment/resource identity and payload digest
G2E EvidenceAdmissionPolicy validates source class, integrity, attempt linkage, freshness/protection, independence, derivation depth and missing-data policy
only G2E admission transition may produce ADMITTED
Adjudication consumes only exact ADMITTED EvidenceRecord refs

adjudication.cardinality: one-shot per ExecutionAttempt; ProofResult may reference multiple adjudications only through frozen INVALID-replacement/multipart semantics
adjudication.gwf_role: persist immutable adjudication mirror and governance disposition only
adjudication.human_role: may attach GovernanceDisposition / authorize next action but cannot rewrite verdict

independence.rule: GWF must enforce equal-or-stricter independence and may not infer independence from provider/model difference alone.
independence.reviewer_rule: when independent QA/reviewer execution is required, it is a separate governed execution context/attempt with its own binding(s) and must satisfy the exact frozen independence dimensions.

revision_and_lineage_rules: G2E object_id/revision_id/content_hash remain canonical and are never replaced by GWF IDs/hashes.
Editorial G2E change creates a new G2E revision; semantic equality must be verified if lineage is retained.
Normative pre-outcome G2E change creates new affected G2E revision and refreezes downstream dependencies.
Normative post-outcome change creates successor proof/study lineage and never rewrites old adjudication.
Frozen WorkAssignment normative mutation requires a new GWF revision/frozen hash and reauthorization; it cannot silently mutate any referenced G2E exact ref.
If a change affects G2E semantics, the new G2E exact revision/successor must exist before any replacement WorkAssignment is frozen.
INVALID technical replacement attempt uses a new G2E attempt_id and a new GWF WorkAssignment/ExecutorBinding; old attempt history remains.
Material agent/harness/provider/model/transport substitution follows G2E equivalence policy and creates a new attempt when material.
Checkpoint/resume may retain exact refs only when semantic identity and protected-resource state remain provably unchanged.
